Definition: Designed Attempts : Rushing attempts scripted by the play call.
Rushing Yards : Total yardage gained on rushing attempts.
Yards per Attempt : Mean yardage per rush.
Yards After Contact : Total yardage gained after the first contact by a defender.
Yards After Contact per Attempt : Mean yardage generated post-contact.
Missed Tackles Forced : Number of tackles evaded by the runner.
Longest : The yardage of the player's longest single run.
Explosive Runs : The first tier of big plays; rushing attempts gaining 10+ yards.
Breakaway Attempts : The second tier of big plays; runs of 15+ yards.
Breakaway Yardage : Total rushing yardage gained specifically on runs of 15+ yards.
Breakaway Percentage : The portion of a runner's total yardage derived from 15+ yard runs.
Elusive Rating : A PFF Signature Stat measuring the success of a runner with the ball independently of the blocking, factoring in missed tackles forced and yards after contact.
Count of designed rushing attempts within specific blocking schemes.
